facts.claim: Arabic 108:1-3 = Tanzil Uthmani strings (ayat[]); CC BY 3.0, verbatim, credit Tanzil Project + link; byte-check on PC required
Hindi = saral bhaavarth from 3 accepted translations (Suhel Farooq Khan, Muhammad Farooq Khan, Mahmud al-Hasan PD); nothing copied; bracket additions not taken
Latin transliteration for the Devanagari ucharan (Tanzil ara-quran-la + quran411 ara-quran-la1), both read

Makki/Madani: IKHTILAAF. Makki: Ibn 'Abbas, al-Kalbi, Muqatil. Madani: al-Hasan, 'Ikrima, Mujahid, Qatada (Qurtubi). Tabari, IK EN, Ma'ariful: no verdict. No majority claimed. Tanzil metadata to check on PC
Order of revelation number: not in any opened source
Other names of the surah: none found in opened sources
Main message: Allah gave the Prophet SAW al-Kawthar -> pray and sacrifice for Him alone -> the one who hates you is the cut off
Surah answers the taunt: the Prophet's remembrance/spiritual line is preserved by Allah until the Day of Assembly (IK); 'spiritual lineage' (Ma'ariful)

Occasion: reports (Tabari, IK EN, Ma'ariful) that opponents in Makka called the Prophet SAW 'abtar' and the surah answers; the named person differs (al-'As bin Wa'il, 'Uqba bin Abi Mu'ayt, Ka'b bin al-Ashraf with Quraysh, Abu Lahab, Quraysh in general). Core agreed; names ikhtilaaf; Tabari: meaning general even if about one person. Video: no name

SAHIH context: Anas bin Malik - the Prophet SAW dozed among the companions, raised his head smiling, recited this surah, saying it was just revealed. Sahih Muslim (number to confirm on PC); cited by Qurtubi 108 only in opened pages
Safe script line: N1 core (taunt and answer, no name) + P2 ikhtilaaf + optional N2. Left out: Ka'b report, Hudaybiyya (munqati'), son's death
No sahih-grade virtue (fazilat) report for reciting 108 was opened; no fazilat claim in the video

108:1 - Kawthar = very great good given to the Prophet SAW; includes a river in Paradise (Anas, Ibn 'Umar reports; Qurtubi: river/pond the strongest views; Tabari prefers river; Ibn 'Abbas via Bukhari: 'the good Allah gave', river is part of it)

108:2 - core: pray to your Lord and sacrifice (nahr) for Him alone, not like idolaters, in thanks for the gift; Tabari: not limited to one prayer or sacrifice; IK: for Allah alone, naming Him (6:162-163, 6:121). Detail views (Eid, Mina, hand-raising) ikhtilaaf - not in video

108:3 - shani'aka = one who hates you; abtar = cut off, without trace/remembrance (Qatada: insignificant, lowly - Tabari); the hater is the cut off; the Prophet's remembrance is kept (IK); Tabari: meaning general even if revealed about a person
Whole surah order: gift -> prayer and sacrifice in thanks -> answer to the taunt (Tabari: general favour, so the command is general)
Allah's gift stands against the enemy's taunt; the one who hates is the cut off (IK); spiritual lineage (Ma'ariful)
